summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: foreign private issuer current report) announcing daily open-market purchases of its own ordinary shares under the existing buyback programme announced 31 July 2026. Over 02-06 November 2026 the company bought 48,401,586; 45,822,881; 25,710,350; 9,158,000; and 10,000,000 shares at volume-weighted prices of roughly 95.20-98.57 pence, with highs near 99.80p. Goldman Sachs International acts as broker under company instructions; purchased shares will be cancelled. Watch execution pace and cancellation-driven share-count reduction.
